parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的交换机预留网段所属的交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch. You can specify up to 10 reserved CIDR blocks
parameters.help_zh: 交换机预留网段的实例ID。最多支持输入10个预留网段
parameters.name: vswitch_cidr_reservation_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch. Valid values: prefix, which indicates that addresses are allocated by CIDR block.

When users or cloud services automatically assign CIDR blocks to elastic network interfaces (ENIs), the CIDR blocks must be allocated from the reserved CIDR block. If all addresses in the reserved CIDR block are allocated, the system returns an error
parameters.help_zh:
交换机预留网段的类型。取值：prefix，表示按段分配地址。

用户及云服务自动为弹性网卡ENI（Elastic Network Interface）分配网段时，必须从预留地址段分配。如果预留地址段的地址已经分配完，则系统会报错
parameters.name: vswitch_cidr_reservation_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP version of the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch. Valid values:

IPv4 (default): IPv4.
IPv6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
交换机预留网段的IP版本。取值：

IPv4 （默认值）：IPv4版本。
IPv6：IPv6版本
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If this is the first request or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
